events.name: donation_result_viewed
events.description: Visitor lands on the thank-you page coming back from a payment rail. Sent once, with the final result: the site asks the provider for the real status with the id in the return URL (Bold order id, Mercado Pago preapproval_id) and falls back to the URL when the provider cannot answer. North Star when donation_success is true. A /gracias visit without provider parameters redirects home and sends nothing.

properties.name: payment_provider
properties.description: Payment rail the visitor came back from (bold, mercado_pago).

properties.name: payment_status
properties.description: Final outcome. Bold: approved, pending, rejected, cancelled (voided). Mercado Pago: authorized, pending, paused, cancelled. subscription_returned only when the Mercado Pago status could not be verified (the visitor came back with a subscription id, the charge is not confirmed).

properties.name: donation_success
properties.description: true for Bold approved and Mercado Pago authorized; also true when unverified and the URL says approved (Bold) or subscription_returned (Mercado Pago). false for pending, rejected and cancelled.

properties.name: verified
properties.description: true if the status came from the provider API (/api/estado-pago); false if the site fell back to what the return URL says (no key, timeout, provider error or unknown status).

properties.name: provider_status_code
properties.description: Raw status in the return URL (bold-tx-status). Only for bold; may differ from payment_status when the provider says otherwise.

properties.name: frequency
properties.description: one_time (bold) or monthly (mercado_pago).

properties.name: amount_value
properties.description: Amount: from the provider when verified (Bold total in COP, Mercado Pago monthly auto_recurring.transaction_amount); otherwise from the Bold order reference. Absent for unverified Mercado Pago.

properties.name: language
properties.description: UI language, sent as a super property on every event (es, en, fr).

properties.description: Device class from viewport width, super property (mobile, tablet, desktop).

rationale: Instruments the website's single conversion journey: turning visitors into supporters through the Súmate panel. Funnel: sumate_opened, sumate_help_type_selected (money), donation_frequency_selected, payment_flow_started, donation_result_viewed (donation_success true). payment_flow_failed measures payments that could not be opened. North Star: donation_result_viewed with donation_success true; amount in COP from Bold approved. Country, city, session and UTM parameters are captured automatically by Mixpanel and are not sent manually. Payment method and monthly amount are chosen inside Bold and Mercado Pago and are not visible to the site. No personal data is collected; session replays block all images because the site shows photos of minors.
